'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War on drugs]], [[2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers]]
**Three people are killed in an [[United States Navy|American]] [[airstrike]] against a boat in the [[Pacific Ocean]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-strikes-another-alleged-drug-boat-eastern-pacific/ (CBS News)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and the [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] sign a [[framework agreement]] in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]], for a [[peace treaty]] to end the conflict in [[Kivu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-m23-sign-framework-agreement-peace-deal-qatar-2025-11-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**Four people are killed, including the mayor of Wady Al-Mawla, and another is severely injured in a [[mass shooting]] by unidentified gunmen at a [[coffeehouse]] in [[Talkalakh]], [[Homs Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/373435/ (Syrian Observatory for Human Rights)] [https://sana.sy/en/governorates-news/homs/2277872/ (SANA)]
**Three people are injured, including two critically, in a [[drive-by shooting]] by unidentified gunmen in Abu Jarin, [[Aleppo Governorate]], Syria. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/373437/ (Syrian Observatory for Human Rights)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Canada–Holy See relations]]
**The [[Holy See]] transfers 62 [[Indigenous peoples in Canada|indigenous]] artifacts to the [[Canadian Conference of Catholic Bishops]] for [[Repatriation (cultural property)|repatriation]] to the communities of origin after their removal for a 1925 missionary exhibition in [[Rome]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c93xv530kxeo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025–26 European windstorm season]]
**[[Storm Claudia (2025)|Storm Claudia]] makes [[landfall]] in [[Western Europe]], killing at least three people and injuring dozens of others in southern [[Portugal]]. [https://www.skynews.com.au/world-news/global-affairs/three-dead-after-storm-claudia-hit-portugal/video/b5ff6ae5246e7ddb7da7e723a361a05d (Sky News Australia)]
*At least 32 [[Illegal mining|informal miners]] are killed when a makeshift bridge collapses at a flooded [[cobalt]] [[Mining industry of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|mine]] in [[Lualaba Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. Authorities state that unauthorized miners entered the area despite a ban due to [[landslide]] risks. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/at-least-32-killed-in-dr-congo-mine-collapse (AFP via ''Daily Sabah'')]
*A landslide triggered by heavy rain kills at least 11 people and leaves 12 others missing in [[Central Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/indonesia-landslide-kills-6-central-java-17-missing-state-media-says-2025-11-15/ (Reuters)]
*Nine people are killed and others are injured in an explosion at a firecracker manufacturing unit in [[Hyderabad, Pakistan|Hyderabad]], [[Sindh]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1955436 (''Dawn'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Mexican protests]]
**At least 120 people are injured, including 100 [[Federal Police (Mexico)|police officers]], and 20 others are arrested in clashes with police during protests across [[Mexico]] after the [[assassination]] of [[Uruapan]] [[Municipal president (Mexico)|mayor]] [[Carlos Manzo]] earlier this month. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/gen-z-styled-protests-spread-mexico-fueled-by-mayors-murder-2025-11-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Modern immigration to the United Kingdom]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[home secretary]] [[Shabana Mahmood]] announces plans to reduce the length of [[refugee status]], extend the required period before applying for [[Right of abode in the United Kingdom|long-term residency]], and end automatic [[Welfare state in the United Kingdom|state benefits]] for asylum seekers as part of a broad reform of its asylum system. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-k-plans-to-drastically-reduce-protections-for-refugees-overhaul-asylum-policies/ (AFP via CBS News)]
*[[Benin]]'s [[National Assembly (Benin)|National Assembly]], by a 99–19 vote, approves a [[Constitution of Benin|constitutional]] [[Constitutional amendment|amendment]] that extends [[President of Benin|presidential]] and parliamentary [[term limit]]s from five to seven years and establishes a new [[senate]], pending review by the [[Constitutional Court of Benin|Constitutional Court]]. The reform would take effect after [[2026 Beninese presidential election|the April presidential election]]. [https://apnews.com/article/benin-constitution-reforms-talon-445cf3b39f7a29c3c96d93bec81ddde9 (AP)]
